verdict.rationale: The evidence gives only building blocks: control listing and monitoring-test endpoints, monitoring training material, audit listing, and a community note that noncompliant personnel show up in the Drata dashboard. Nothing in the pack documents a per-framework readiness view or a single readiness percentage. missing for 10: documented per-framework readiness dashboard, a readiness percentage combining passing controls and open gaps, a breakdown of remaining work, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the percentage is accurate.
